name: carte-blanche-apilib
description: Spending mandates, sealed receipts and dispute-proof audits for AI agents paying with PayPal.  The agent boundary is `POST /api/agent/purchase`: every call is checked against a signed, immutable mandate *before* money moves, executed with a deterministic `PayPal-Request-Id` (a retry can never double-spend), and answered with a signed receipt — or a signed proof of refusal. Every event lands in an append-only SHA-256 chain with signed checkpoints, CT-style Merkle inclusion proofs and RFC 3161 TSA anchoring.  This contract is ready for APIMatic import (developer portal + SDK generation): point it at the raw `openapi.json` served by the live instance.
